description: FINISH a 480p Seedance 2.5 DRAFT in 1080p: the model regenerates THAT take (same scene, shots, motion, sound) at full resolution. Every 480p Seedance 2.5 render (generate_video / render_ad at resolution 480p) is a draft, finishable for 7 days; its result carries `draft` {id, expiresAt, finishCredits}. Pass that id, or the draft video URL. It is the full-resolution route for a draft (upscale_video is for a video that is not a draft); priced like a 1080p render of its length. Paid: call with dryRun first, state the credits, run only when the user agrees. Captions, end card or music added after the draft are not re-applied. Not a draft or expired: a plain refusal; use upscale_video or a fresh 1080p render.

draft.description: the draft id from the render result (draft.id)

dryRun.description: true = return the estimated credits and render nothing

video.description: or: the URL of the 480p draft video

name: finish_draft
title: Finish a draft in 1080p
